profile.headline: Veteran | Visionary Pathmaker | Champion of Change & Process Improvement | ServiceNow Enthusiast | Trailblazer | TS SCI
profile.summary:
Experienced leader with a strong background in the Military industry, currently providing Data Center Infrastructure Management solutions to the US Air Force. I develop a Secure Supply Chain module in ServiceNow for comprehensive tracking of requests and assets. As an ISSM for the DCIM System and System Administrator, I manage patching and security configurations, oversee Group Policy settings, and administer applications such as Microsoft SQL Server, IIS, Windows Server 2016, SQL Reporting Service, and Nlyte Enterprise.

I seamlessly turn visionary ideas into practical actions using foresight to anticipate and actively shape the future. My expertise includes DNS, DHCP, network-attached storage, Sidewinder Firewall, Active Directory, Group Policy, Public Key Infrastructure, DISA STIG Compliance, Command Cyber Readiness Inspections, and security across Microsoft Exchange and Solarwinds. I excel in system analysis, load and capacity planning, event log management, backups and data recovery, fault recovery, trouble ticketing, response, outage scheduling, and deconfliction.

Additionally, I have experience in airport operations and logistics, with past certifications in Hazardous Materials inspection and preparation.

positions.title: System Engineer/Administrator/Security Manager/Software Developer
positions.description:
Responsible for the engineering of DCIM solution utilizing Nlyte software and APC products which provide environmental monitoring, flood detection, power utilization/capacity, and rack access for multiple datacenters supporting the United States Air Force Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance Mission.  

Manage two VMWare ESX environments providing the DCIM solution as well as a development lab.  Management includes patching and regular updates as well as testing, configuration baselines, technical documentation, license, software, and configuration management.  

Responsible for utilizing the RMF framework to submit solutions for approval, maintaining systems in compliance with Secure Technical Implementation Guides and remediating any vulnerabilities discovered via ACAS/Tenable vulnerability scans.
Submit SIA for system modifications to remain in compliance with RMF

Primary developer for ServiceNow custom application providing cradle to grave tracking of purchase requests through asset retirement utilizing custom tables, forms, workflows, UI actions, business rules, client scripts, script includes, and creating custom menus.  Utilized DevOps and Agile methods for product development and use of software source control and managing the software development environment utilizing GitHub repositories, branches, and tags

positions.title: Manager, Cyberspace weapon systems
positions.description:
As a manager of a USAF Cyber weapon system, My team ensured subordinate organizations received the proper allocation of personnel to complete their mission objectives through collaboration with other organizations.  We also directed the training of systems, both already procured and those going through the procurement process.  I ensured organization personnel were considered with regard to training materials and equipment to meet current and future mission objectives.   Lastly, as a member of a larger team, together with the finance team, we ensured organizations received the funding they require over the next five years by prioritizing projects to ensure the Air Force mission is completed.

Additionally I was assisgned as the SSR in conjunction with ISSO where I worked directly with the SSO to ensure security controls of our facility were compliant with Intelligence Community Standards in order to allow our facility to become a SCIF.  This position required the proper markings of systems and facility as well as maintaining a file plan for monthly security checks, visitor logs, and Entry Authorization lists for 63 pesronnel.  Additionally I was the facility manager where I am responsible to ensure the facility is maintained in accordance with local regulations. I submitted 12 work orders to repair issues with the facility, secured the facility during hurricane warnings, tracked all keys for the facility and performed inspections.

positions.title: Procedure and Training Manager
positions.description: I led a team that provided critical system metrics in support of Defensive Cyber Operations taskings which fostered other units ability to provide thier desired effects across the enterprise network.  I also reinvigorated the analytics mission where I reduced data insight deficiencies and enabled data analysis capabilities by planning the deployment of a new logging server. Additionally my team developed network configurations and established a root cause analysis tool which enabled further cyber threat analytics and mitigation.  Lastly, my team eliminated 5200 vulnerabilities across 52 servers, as well as completed 29,000 security configuration compliance checks which enabled my team found and eradicated 1.4K critical vulnerabilities on the network.

positions.title: Enterprise Network Monitoring Manager
positions.description: Led remote and local personnel across multiple functional areas responsible for monitoring & analytics of USAF Enterprise Network.  In this position, I was also the functional lead for Monitoring where I directed crew position training and stan eval standards for the entire cyber security and control system weapon system as well as standardized operations and configuration of procedures.  I also consolidated monitoring instances to streamline data and provide better analytics on network events.  Additionally I directed device configurations and monitored network infrastructure profiling software which enabled real-time system reporting to administrators and Cyber Monitoring Cell.  Finally I was responsible to manage network health monitoring tools such as Solarwinds suite of applications, IBM Tivoli NetCool and Microsoft System Center Operations Manager where my team providee proactive & reactive secure management capabilities.

positions.title: Passenger Service Agent Supervisor
positions.locationName: 726 Air Mobility Squadron, Rhein Main AB, Germany
positions.description:
I ensured passengers were taken care of from the time they walked in the door to the time they boarded the plane.  I assisted passengers with signup, selection, check-in, baggage handling, planing and deplaning.  I was responsible for verificaiton of documentation to enter and exit the country as well as immigration and boarder clearance standards based on directives.  

As supervisor I also ensured the funds manager had accurate fund tracking with 0 discrepancies.  Expedited over 50% of DoD's war fighters on 13,000 Operation Enduring Freedom and Operation Iraqi Freedom missions.  I also was responsible to perform quality assurance of contractors to ensure they complied with regulations while providing food service, aircraft cleaning and refueling of commercial aircraft to our Air Force.  As a side project I also wrote multiple databases to ensure workcenter historical documentation was tracked and filed properly while identifying areas for improvement based off of analytics.

positions.title: Cargo Specialist / Special Handler / Aircraft Services Supervisor
positions.locationName: 726 Air Mobility Squadron, Rhein Main AB, Germany
positions.description:
I ensured all cargo (regular, special handling, mail, etc) that transited my facility was properly marked and prepared for movement within the transportation system, whether by air, land or sea.  I also inspected any hazardous materials to ensure that they complied with standards and requirements in order to be shipped as well as ensured all labeling, marking, and documentation requirements are met while maintinaing records of shipments.

I was also responsible for the cleaning and servicing of transient aircraft to include providing and inventorying expendable and nonexpendable items as well as ensuring the lavatories were clean and the aircraft had water, pillows and blankets for passengers.  During this time I was also selected ahead of my peers for early promotion based on performance at the next level

positions.title: Cargo Specialist
positions.locationName: 60th Aerial Port Squadron, Travis AFB, CA
positions.description:
As a cargo specialist I received, inspected, processed and zoned cargo into the database system for tracking and scheduling to destinations.  I also performed quality control inspections of documentation, packaging, loading and handling.  Working in the warehouse I was trained to operate various forklift sizes and capabilities. During my time loading aircraft I operated aircraft loading equipment.

Processed 2,712 tons monthly for Pacific theater with at 99.99% on time departure reliability rate.

Expertly inspected, configured, and palletized 517 tons of FEMA relief supplies for victims of Puerto Rico and Honduras in the wake of Hurricanes George and Mitch.

Hand picked for short notice deployment to Ramstein AB, Germany where I processed 22,751 tons of supplies on 648 aircraft in support of Operation Shining Hope, which was humanitarian aid for 300,000 Kosovo refugees.
